name: Moped
description: A two- or three-wheeler with foot pedals and an independent power source of no more than 2 brake horsepower (1,500 W) that can't propel it faster than 30 mph unassisted; a pedaled electric bike whose motor can push a 170-pound rider past 20 mph lands here while it stays within those limits.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and foot pedals for muscular propulsion
Its power source provides no more than 2 brake horsepower (1,500 W) and can't propel it faster than 30 mph unassisted on a level surface
An automatic drive: no clutching or shifting once the drive system is engaged
Not a motor vehicle or a motorcycle under state law
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a helmet
Has the rights and duties of any other vehicle's driver on the road, and is ridden only on a permanent, regular seat
May use the highway, its shoulder and bike lanes under power; on sidewalks and bike paths only under pedal power
Kept off sidewalks and crosswalks where traffic control devices prohibit it, and yields to pedestrians on them
